generation.scope: All rank-ten finite one-sided symmetric regular windows in a fixed phase lie in one irreducible fourteen-dimensional closure. The entire both-bundle candidate locus is parameterized by smooth projected elliptic octics or quartic maps to Gr(2,4), with exact indexed isomorphism and half-period via projective equivalence and Grassmann duality. Its geometric generic point is regular.

open_mathematics: Prove regularity or isolate exceptional fibers on the quartic Grassmann locus. Use the quartic K3 surface and the four line bundles of its two elliptic pencils to control the four-vertex Serre iterates.
